name: Acid mosaic
description: One bar of eight stepped cutoff accents, a two-bar moving peak and alternating Q. 1/8-note grid.

name: Bass portcullis
description: Sixteen high-pass shutters per bar, four peak positions and half-time Q accents.

name: Broken telephone
description: Band-pass syllables on a 1/8 grid, with an offset peak and stuttering resonance width.

name: Comb lock
description: Positive comb teeth jump between eight positions while the peak answers every two bars.

name: Notch code
description: A sixteen-step spectral barcode. Cutoff, peak and Q each follow a different block sequence.

name: Ascending stairwell
description: Eight rising ramps per bar with changing heights; a slow peak climb and inverted Q answer.

name: Descending teeth
description: Eight falling band-pass teeth per bar, with rising peak motion and gentle Q steps.

name: Glass elevator
description: Two-bar high-pass ascent beneath a falling resonant peak; Q rides a one-bar triangle.

name: Reverse vacuum
description: Negative comb suction: four rising/falling cells, slow resonant drift and a narrow Q breath.

name: Shelf surf
description: Low-shelf ramps trade warm pulses and lean gaps; moving peak and Q keep the surface alive.

name: Dotted orbit
description: Dotted cutoff circles against triplet peak movement and a straight two-bar Q pulse.

name: Half-time / double-time
description: A half-speed bass sweep, double-speed stepped peak and straight Q ramps share the main BPM.

name: Independent city · 93 / 127 BPM
description: Cutoff follows the main BPM; peak runs at independent 93 BPM and Q at 127 BPM. Deliberate phase drift.

name: Triplet switchyard
description: Triplet block cutoffs, dotted falling peak ramps and a straight Q pulse: three interlocking clocks.

name: Deep current · 0.07 / 0.11 / 0.17 Hz
description: Three slow independent oscillations turn a steep low-pass into a long, evolving tide.

name: Flutter engine · 7.3 Hz
description: Fast cutoff flutter against a 0.23 Hz resonant sweep and 1.7 Hz Q tremor.

name: Liquid phase · 0.19 / 0.31 Hz
description: All-pass cascades, counter-running cutoff/peak movement and slow Q drift.

name: Radio creep · 0.13 / 0.47 Hz
description: A wandering narrow-band receiver with asymmetrical drift and a slow resonance breath.

name: Shimmer shelf · 0.41 / 2.9 Hz
description: High-shelf colour slowly rises and falls while its resonant edge shivers independently.

name: Alien loom
description: Negative comb with a fractured 0.37 Hz cutoff, dotted BPM peak blocks and a 1.13 Hz Q drift.

name: Clockwork reef
description: A synced comb ramp grows through four heights while two unrelated Hz clocks move the peak and width.

name: Insect choir
description: 18.7 Hz fractured band-pass motion, 3.17 Hz peak flutter and slow Q breathing. Deliberately nervous.

name: Spectral origami
description: A 16-pole notch folds around stepped BPM cutoff, a 0.43 Hz asymmetric peak and dotted Q movement.

name: Tidal interference
description: An independent 83 BPM low-pass tide crosses a main-tempo triplet peak and a slow 0.07 Hz Q current.

name: Afterhours lattice
description: Eight syncopated low-pass blocks per bar, a half-speed peak reply and quarter-note Q accents. All lanes follow main BPM.

name: Amber syncopator
description: A sixteen-step band-pass groove with bright offbeats; slower peak steps and alternating Q keep the accents moving.

name: Bassline burglar
description: High-pass shutters alternate deep and lean bass windows on an eighth-note grid, with a slow descending peak and Q reply.

name: Broken escalator
description: A notched step sequence climbs, slips and catches itself; the resonant peak answers at half-time while Q descends.

name: Clocked consonants
description: Four clipped band-pass syllables per beat pair, with an offset peak pattern and eighth-note Q articulation. Fully tempo locked.

name: Concrete clave
description: Low-pass clave-like accents hit an uneven eight-cell pattern; peak and Q echo across one and two bars without leaving the main clock.

name: Dental drill
description: Sixteen positive-comb teeth jump per bar while the peak alternates each beat and Q breathes over two bars. Metallic, not free running.

name: Offbeat shutters
description: Deep high-pass openings sit between the beats; an inverted peak orbit and alternating Q make the offbeats change colour.

name: Pocket percussion
description: A moving resonant peak adds pitched ticks to the groove; cutoff hops every eighth and Q answers at quarter-note speed.

name: Switchblade shuffle
description: Triplet-grid notch blocks shuffle against a straight peak staircase and a two-bar Q triangle. Every clock follows the main tempo.

name: Acid raincatcher
description: Eight falling cutoff teeth catch changing accents; the peak climbs four ramps and Q leans against each drop. Main-BPM sync throughout.

name: Backspin prism
description: Negative-comb ramps pull upward in pitch as the resonant peak falls; Q pulses at double speed for a clocked reverse-spin texture.

name: Cable-car ascent
description: A two-bar high-pass rise moves through four different heights while its independent peak descends and Q sways once per bar.

name: Falling dominoes
description: Sixteen short band-pass decays tumble over one bar; a two-bar peak staircase and alternating Q create a longer phrase.

name: Ratchet blossom
description: Cutoff blooms in eight rising ramps per beat, the peak answers in quarter-bar falls and Q changes every bar. Fast but still BPM locked.

name: Reverse turbine
description: Rising comb ramps rotate through four polarities; a falling peak and slow Q orbit turn the loop into a tempo-bound turbine.

name: Sawtooth semaphore
description: Notch flags fall at alternating heights on an eighth grid; the peak rises over two bars while Q answers with four accents.

name: Spiral staircase
description: Sixteen ascending cutoff ramps repeat a four-accent phrase; the peak spirals at half-time and Q at quarter-time.

name: Upside-down waterfall
description: A high-shelf waterfall alternates upward and downward ramp heights; the peak descends while Q rises in counter-motion.

name: Zipline teeth
description: High-pass ramps zip across one-beat cycles; a dotted peak fall crosses them and Q anchors a straight bar. Locked to the shared BPM.

name: Bronze triplet press
description: Triplet comb blocks stamp against a straight peak ramp and dotted Q tide. Three clock divisions share one main BPM.

name: Crosswalk canon
description: Straight, triplet and dotted triangles cross at different phases, reshaping a low-pass phrase without any free-running clock.

name: Dotted dominoes
description: Dotted band-pass decays tumble over straight peak steps and triplet Q ramps, giving the same bar a constantly changing accent.

name: Hemiola engine
description: A dotted half-bar cutoff cycle meets a straight half-bar peak and triplet Q blocks: a clock-locked three-against-two machine.

name: Lopsided carousel
description: A negative comb turns on a dotted bar; the peak spins in triplets and Q rises every two straight bars. No drifting Hz lane.

name: Pendulum interchange
description: A high-pass pendulum follows a straight two-bar arc while dotted peak and triplet Q motion swap the emphasis underneath.

name: Six against four
description: Triplet one-beat cutoff blocks run six cycles per bar against four straight peak cycles; Q takes a slow dotted orbit.

name: Three doors down
description: Dotted quarter-note notch ramps open three-beat phrases against a one-bar peak triangle and triplet Q steps.

name: Triplet pressure
description: Resonant band-pass pressure rises in triplet ramps, falls in dotted peak teeth and relaxes on a straight two-bar Q envelope.

name: Woven sixes
description: A low-shelf triplet drift weaves around dotted peak blocks and a straight Q sine. Soft colour with a clocked, changing weave.

name: Aurora scaffolding
description: An eight-bar low-pass aurora crosses a four-bar peak drift and a two-bar Q arc. Slow evolution stays tied to the main BPM.

name: Cathedral tide
description: A sixteen-bar positive-comb tide moves below an eight-bar resonant arc and a four-bar Q breath. Spacious but exactly tempo related.

name: Deep-space drawbridge
description: Four long high-pass ramps lift across eight bars, with a slower peak orbit and a two-bar Q response; all are main-tempo synced.

name: Eight-bar breathing
description: An eight-bar low-pass inhale meets an inverted four-bar peak exhale; resonance breathes over two bars without losing the shared clock.

name: Glacier transmitter
description: A sixteen-bar notch drift slowly retunes the spectrum while the peak steps every bar and Q traces a four-bar triangle.

name: Low-orbit bloom
description: A resonant peak blooms over four bars; a differently phased eight-bar peak-position curve and two-bar Q pulse keep the orbit evolving.

name: Midnight estuary
description: Band-pass currents meet over eight and sixteen bars, with a four-bar Q tide. All three long cycles remain related to the main tempo.

name: Slow-motion origami
description: Sixteen-pole notch folds stretch over eight bars, while a four-bar peak ramp and two-bar Q staircase redraw the edges.

name: Submerged skyline
description: A warm low shelf rises over eight bars; the resonant skyline drifts over sixteen and Q changes in four-bar breaths.

name: Tectonic lantern
description: Negative-comb tectonic ramps shift across sixteen bars under an eight-bar peak tide and a four-bar Q flicker. Everything follows main BPM.

name: Alloy beehive
description: Fractured positive-comb motion repeats every beat while triplet peak steps and a dotted Q orbit make a metallic, main-clock swarm.

name: Binary jellyfish
description: An all-pass body swims in stepped quarter-bar pulses, with a two-bar asymmetrical peak and dotted Q tendrils. BPM locked in every lane.

name: Clockwork chimera
description: Triplet negative-comb teeth meet straight rising peak ramps and a dotted fractured Q curve. Three strange motions, one shared clock.

name: Digital mangrove
description: A branching low-pass fracture repeats every two bars; sixteen peak steps form roots while Q drifts over four bars. No Hz clocks.

name: Folded metropolis
description: A steep notch city folds through two-bar bipolar ramps; triplet peak blocks and a one-bar Q fracture animate the streets.

name: Glass centipede
description: Sixteen band-pass legs step per bar while the peak sweeps a one-beat triangle and Q crawls along a dotted two-bar phrase.

name: Magnetic orchard
description: Resonant-peak branches bend with a dotted drift while falling peak-position cells and straight Q steps magnetically change their colour.

name: Negative-space engine
description: Negative-comb gaps cut a sixteen-step spectral pattern, with a slow inverse peak triangle and a triplet Q pulse. Entirely main-BPM locked.

name: Spectral pinball
description: A high-shelf pinball ricochets through fractured half-bar motion; peak blocks jump each beat and Q follows a dotted triangle.

name: Wormhole turnstile
description: All-pass ramps fold phase every beat while a triplet resonant drift and four-bar Q orbit open a clocked wormhole through the loop.
